title: Dolan's USO database shows EM interference patterns

tellings.quote: I noticed about 10% of all the cases involved EM interference.

plain: The researcher Richard Dolan says that about one in ten of the cases in his database of USOs, unidentified objects seen in or coming out of the world's oceans, involved electromagnetic interference, meaning electrical equipment was disrupted. He describes this as a pattern he noticed himself while collecting the cases, and he does not name a source. If it holds, it would point to a shared physical effect behind the sightings.
